title: A pull quote
summary: A blockquote with a serif face, a larger size and a coloured rule, credited below.
explanation: blockquote comes with large side margins from the browser. Resetting margin to 0 and adding padding-left with a border-left gives the classic quote rule instead.
A change of typeface (a serif against sans-serif body text) and a larger size set the quote apart without any extra decoration.
The credit is a small, muted line under the quote, so the quote stays the focus.
tryThis: Remove margin: 0 from .quote: the browser's default indent comes back.
Change the font-family of .quote to system-ui, sans-serif: it blends into the page.
Make the border-left 8px wide and a lighter colour.

children.text: Good typography is invisible. Bad typography is everywhere.
